scenario_a_success.title: Scenario A: Successful Appointment Offer & Explicit Confirmation
scenario_a_success.description: Representative offers Monday 11:00 AM (matching preferences and office hours) and explicitly confirms upon request.

turns.message: Namaskara! This is the Social Welfare Department Helpdesk. Yes, we have document verification appointment slots open on Monday at 11:00 AM. Would you like to schedule for that time?
Yes, Monday at 11:00 AM is confirmed for this simulated enquiry. Please bring the original documents for verification at the commissionerate office.

scenario_b_no_availability.title: Scenario B: No Available Slots
scenario_b_no_availability.description: Representative states that no verification slots are currently available in the requested window.

turns.message: Namaskara! We currently have no appointment slots open in that time window this week. All physical verification slots are fully booked.

scenario_c_missing_info.title: Scenario C: Missing Information & WhatsApp Contact Handoff
scenario_c_missing_info.description: Representative asks for applicant personal details; when refused under Zero-PII, provides official WhatsApp number for direct citizen submission.

turns.message: Namaskara! Before we can check the appointment register, please provide the applicant's 11-digit college admission acknowledgment number and parent Aadhaar RD reference.

metadata.requested_info: 11-digit college admission acknowledgment number and parent Aadhaar RD reference

turns.message: Understood. The applicant can WhatsApp their acknowledgment details directly to our verification desk at +919845012345.

scenario_d_unclear_unsupported.title: Scenario D: Unsupported Channel / Ambiguous Response
scenario_d_unclear_unsupported.description: Representative states that this enquiry cannot be handled over this channel and requires in-person or official portal contact.

turns.message: We cannot process verification enquiries or bookings through this desk channel. Verification policies have changed and require an in-person token or direct portal grievance.

metadata.reason: Channel unsupported; direct in-person token required.
